open_points.subject: Import confirmation after re-uploading identical bytes
open_points.text: A16 says another upload replaces the kept file, “one of the same bytes included,” and requires confirmation of the earlier mapping to be refused even then; but A13 binds the confirmation only to the import file's digest and picks, and M11 carries no upload identity or generation.
open_points.question: How can Registry distinguish the file upload for which the confirmation was shown from a later upload with the same bytes, and does an accepted upload clear the pending confirmation or add another value to its binding?
options: Every accepted upload invalidates or clears the pending import confirmation.
The pending confirmation carries an upload generation or file-instance identity in addition to the digest.
Digest equality makes the later identical upload satisfy the earlier confirmation.
open_points.default_guess: Clear the pending import confirmation on every accepted upload.

witness.initial: An owner session holds uploaded file F; its mapping has no errors, and Registry has shown confirmation C bound to digest(F) and the chosen mapping inputs.
events: The owner uploads F again with exactly the same bytes in the same session.
The owner submits the earlier confirmation C with the same picks and Customer values.
outcomes: A16 requires refusal because the upload for which C was shown is no longer kept, even though the replacement has the same bytes.
A13's specified digest binding matches the currently kept file and inputs, so an implementation with only the stated M11 facts accepts the import.
witness.observer: The owner sees either a refused confirmation requiring a new step or a committed import.

open_points.subject: Security review status after changes to reviewed decisions
open_points.text: A21 rule 2 says, “A change to a decision a category names reopens this review,” while the review still says “Security review: PERFORMED” and “this review is complete”; A04, A13 and A16, all named by its categories, have changed.
open_points.question: Has the security review been performed again against the changed A04, A13 and A16, and if so what are its renewed category outcomes and references?
options: The review is reopened and is not complete until it is performed again.
The changed rules were re-reviewed and every published outcome is reaffirmed.
One or more category outcomes or references change after the renewed review.
open_points.default_guess: Treat A21 as reopened and not yet complete.

witness.initial: A21 is marked performed and complete and names A04, A13 and A16 in its concurrency and other applicable categories.
events: The accepted text of A04 changes its revision and refusal precedence.
The accepted text of A13 changes confirmation binding for actions showing no revision or access version.
The accepted text of A16 changes confirmation availability and identical-file replacement behavior.
No renewed security-review result is recorded.
outcomes: A21 rule 2 makes the security review reopened and its completeness claim no longer current.
The unchanged review status is read as continuing to certify the modified decisions.
witness.observer: Later security reviewers and implementing agents disagree on whether States 0–2 have a completed accepted security review.
